style.styleTitle: Sugar Plum Fairy First Christmas Bauble by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: Mark a magical first Christmas with this personalised Sugar Plum Fairy bauble. It can be personalised with the child s name, surname, date and First Christmas year, displayed on the banner. The design is printed onto a wooden insert and displayed inside a clear glass bauble with artificial snow, finished with a velvet ribbon in a colour of your choice. A beautiful personalised First Christmas decoration, fairy Christmas ornament and keepsake gift.
